BrochureContent.Content:
Maher Auctioneers are delighted to present this exceptional agricultural and equestrian holding extending to approximately 57 acres in the highly regarded farming area of Clonoulty, Co. Tipperary. The property includes a charming two-storey period farmhouse set within the landholding, along with an impressive range of modern agricultural and equestrian facilities, making it a unique and versatile countryside property.

The lands comprise highly productive, free-draining permanent grassland, ideally suited to a range of agricultural and equestrian uses. Benefiting from direct frontage onto a main regional road, the property is accessed via an impressive tarmac entrance avenue, leading into a substantial and well-laid-out farmyard complex.

A standout feature of the holding is the recently constructed state-of-the-art equestrian stable block, finished to an exceptional standard and immediately operational. The modern equestrian complex elevates the property into a premium category and includes high-quality facilities designed to support professional or private equestrian operations. Additional features include mains water, electricity connection, gravelled yard areas, concrete yard apron, and a substantial haybarn.

The two-storey farmhouse, approached from the main entrance avenue, features Georgian-influenced sash windows, a traditional multi-chimney roofline, and an Ardner-style finish, offering excellent character and presence. While the farmhouse requires modernisation, it presents a superb opportunity to restore and enhance a property of genuine charm and heritage.

This holding may suit a wide variety of purchasers, including a farming family seeking a principal residence, an equestrian operator requiring on-site accommodation, or a developer/investor seeking a strategically positioned and versatile landholding.

Clonoulty is a highly regarded rural location positioned approximately 10 minutes from Cashel and within an hour of Limerick, Cork, and Kilkenny, offering excellent accessibility while maintaining a peaceful countryside setting.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a premium agricultural and equestrian property in one of Tipperary’s most desirable farming regions.

For any further inquiries, feel free to reach out to our Sales Team via email or phone. Please note that we have not tested any appliances, fixtures, fittings, or services, and interested parties are encouraged to carry out their own investigations regarding their functionality. All measurements are approximate, and photographs are provided for guidance only. Viewing strictly by appointment only through Maher Auctioneers, 062-61221.

•	Approx. 10 minutes from Cashel and within an hour of Limerick, Cork & Kilkenny
